# B Sculpt

> B Sculpt (B Sculpt Pty Ltd) is a non-invasive body contouring clinic in Osborne Park, Perth, Western Australia, for men and women aged 18 and over. It offers Cold – fat freezing (cryolipolysis) with the CoolSlimming Ultimate 360, and Warm – skin tightening, body contouring and a temporary reduction in the appearance of cellulite with the Venus Legacy (Multi-Polar RF + PEMF), on the body and face. Every course starts with a consultation. Slogan: "Define Your Shape".

The brand name is "B Sculpt" (also written BSculpt or B-Sculpt).

- Practitioner: Sonya plans and carries out every treatment and sees each client at every follow-up

## Treatments

- [Cold – Fat freezing (cryolipolysis)](https://www.bsculpt.com.au/fat-freezing/): non-invasive controlled cooling with the CoolSlimming Ultimate 360 to reduce the fat layer in a targeted area (abdomen, flanks, thighs, arms and smaller areas). Up to four applicators can be used at once; sessions take under an hour. The body clears treated fat cells over the following weeks to months.
- [Warm – Skin tightening (Multi-Polar RF + PEMF)](https://www.bsculpt.com.au/skin-tightening/): Venus Legacy Multi-Polar Radio Frequency and Pulsed Electro Magnetic Fields, used over a course of sessions for skin tightening, body contouring and a temporary reduction in the appearance of cellulite. Applicators for the abdomen, thighs and back, arms and smaller areas, and the face and neck.
- Consultation: every course starts with a consultation covering goals, health history and suitability, with measurements recorded so changes can be tracked.

## What B Sculpt is not

- Not a weight-loss clinic, and the treatments are not a substitute for a healthy lifestyle, diet or exercise.
- No needles and no surgery. B Sculpt does not offer injectables or peptides.
- Results vary between individuals. A consultation determines whether a treatment is suitable.
